name: Metaball Field Evaluation
aliases: Metaball Field Evaluation — GPU Field Generation
definition: Evaluates a dynamic scalar field composed of three moving metaballs (spheres) for density calculation at a point $(x,y,z)$.
summary: Metaball Field Evaluation is a CPU-GPU pipeline that generates and updates a 3D density volume for dynamic metaballs using compute shaders, explicitly handling temporal animation of ball positions and powers.
